laws.rule: Volcán San Pedro: outside the published 06:00-13:00 Monday-Sunday window, prior authorisation of the administration is required. CONAP identifies the San Pedro La Laguna guide association as handling tourism and recommends contacting administration beforehand; that recommendation is not restated as a universal mandatory-guide law.
